title: Meet the house Nyborgs, and set up your match
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: Your Nyborg has opponents with names now: Biscuit, Noodle, Captain Fuzz, Pepper, Mumble and Marigold, each with their own hairdo and a build on the same 9 points as yours.
Race and Tank open one match setup screen: your Nyborg against the house, with any slot swappable for one of your own Nyborgs, 2 to 4 cars on the Ring, and a seed you can shuffle.
next: Watching inside the app, with a finish card.
